evidence.quote: rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Instituting a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to security/stability (conservation) and to mastery/readiness as a practiced capability (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Aphoristic framing equates unrehearsed with non-existent, appealing to competence (capability must be proven through practice) and conservation (security that is not tested is not real security).
Cadence label restates the recurring-practice commitment, carrying the same conservation and competence values as the directive that established it.
Naming an owner appeals to autonomy — self-origination of the rehearsal process under a named individual's direction.

mints.name: UnrehearsedIsUnowned
mints.title: a capability not rehearsed is a capability not actually had
mints.frame: Is the value move here equating a security or readiness claim with its proven, practiced form — framing untested capability as no capability at all?
